home.subTitle: Frontend developer
home.description: I'm a frontend developer passionate about crafting clean, responsive, and user-friendly web interfaces. With a strong foundation in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern frameworks like React, I build seamless digital experiences that are both functional and visually engaging

about.description: Starting in early 2025, I have been working as an intern at a startup with an international team, where I develop a frontend part of a web platform using React, TypeScript, and AntDesign. My responsibilities include creating responsive and visually appealing pages based on Figma designs, collaborating closely with the designer, and addressing various inquiries throughout development. I use Git for version control to ensure smooth project management and team collaboration

description: Creating responsive web pages based on Figma designs and implementing adaptive layouts for major screen sizes
Building and integrating user registration/login flows: registration, login, forgot/reset password, email confirmation
Routing setup with React Router, including NotFound pages for invalid users/companies
Designing and implementing complex form flows, including: custom field rendering by type (text, date, file, GeoJSON, etc); dynamic validation and conditional logic
Integration with HubSpot for form submissions and CRM pipelines
Merging form logic with both the backend (Strapi) and HubSpot workflows to display, store, and process client data (confirmation emails, quote requests, contact info)
Worked on the layout of web pages based on existing designs
Administered and moderated websites, ensuring smooth operations and user engagement
Managed brand pages on social media platforms, including Facebook and Instagram
Wrote engaging infotainment content and translated business correspondence and other materials to/from English and Ukrainian
Gathered analytical data based on specific criteria, and compiled detailed reports
Provided online user support and maintained communication with customers
Managed databases and archives using specialized software and MS Office tools
